verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a REST-based API v2 that can programmatically book meetings via its Scheduling API endpoint, create event types (POST /event_types), and retrieve event-type availability. A community developer reports building a client scheduling integration on Calendly, which makes it enough to embed scheduling in your own product. However, availability is only shown as readable (with a 31-day window per request), not writable or configurable via the API, and full lifecycle management of event types and bookings (update, cancel, reschedule) is not evidenced. missing for 10: documented API write or management of availability schedules, documented update/delete of event types and cancel/reschedule of bookings via REST, independent hands-on corroboration of the booking endpoint.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented REST API lets me manage event types, availability, and bookings programmatically — enough to build scheduling into my own product
